_comment: Multi-editor settings for readability-first coding. Apply the relevant section to your editor. IntelliJ IDEA users: configure these equivalents under Settings > Editor > Code Style > Java/Python — disable 'Organize imports on the fly', disable 'Code cleanup on save', and disable auto-refactoring suggestions.

intellij-idea._comment: Descriptive guidance only — not actual IDE config keys. IntelliJ IDEA stores settings as XML under .idea/. Configure these manually under Settings > Editor > Code Style > Java/Python and Settings > Editor > Inspections: disable 'Optimize imports on the fly', disable 'Code cleanup' on save, disable auto-refactoring suggestions.
